description: How many crosstab headings are allowed. A four-way cross join of digit table D pivots a.d*100 + b.d*10 + c.d with one row group, limited to n distinct headings for n = 253, 254, 255, 256, 300 and 1000. Asks for each the OpenRecordset result, Fields Count and Names, and the first row's values, which show where and how the limit appears and whether headings are cut off silently.
retentionNote: Designed r-sql-2-3 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
